districtAwards.description: THE PROPOSED PROJECT WILL SUPPORT CLOSING THE BROADBAND AVAILABILITY GAP AND SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT OF A FIVE-YEAR ACTION PLAN. THE PROPOSED PROJECT INCLUDES THE FOLLOWING PLANNING AND PRE-DEPLOYMENT ACTIVITIES AND EXPECTED OUTCOMES: THE APPLICANT WILL CONDUCT RESEARCH AND DATA COLLECTION THAT WILL SUPPORT THE ONGOING DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT OF THE LOUISIANA STATEWIDE BROADBAND MAP; FACILITATE ENGAGEMENT OF STAKEHOLDERS IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE 5-YEAR ACTION PLAN THROUGH PUBLICATIONS AND OTHER OUTREACH; CONDUCT TRAININGS FOR BROADBAND PROGRAM STAFF AND CONTRACTORS TO ENABLE THEM TO EXECUTE THE BEAD PROGRAM; SUPPORT THE INCREASE IN STAFF AND CONTRACTS OF THE BROADBAND OFFICE IN ORDER TO EXECUTE THE BEAD PROGRAM; CONDUCT ASSET MAPPING, WHICH WILL INFORM THE 5-YEAR ACTION PLAN; CONDUCT SURVEYS OF UNSERVED, UNDERSERVED, AND UNDERREPRESENTED COMMUNITIES TO BETTER UNDERSTAND BARRIERS TO ADOPTION; AND SUPPORT COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH MEETING THE LOCAL COORDINATION REQUIREMENTS INCLUDING CAPACITY BUILDING AT THE LOCAL AND REGIONAL LEVELS OR CONTRACTED SUPPORT TO SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE 5-YEAR ACTION PLAN. THE INTENDED BENEFICIARIES ARE THE STATE OF LOUISIANA AND PRINCIPALLY UNSERVED AND UNDERSERVED COMMUNITIES IN THE STATE. THE RECIPIENT DOES NOT INTEND TO SUBAWARD FUNDS.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
